name: Alice
source: [url=/c91602]Jack's[/url] childhood friend and classmate who walks to school with him every morning because their houses are near each other. She is always worried about Jack because he has been always particularly kind to her. Though calculative and serious most of the time, Alice lets her emotions free when she talks to or talks about Jack. Her Chishiki power lets her to teleport into Jack's room.
